{{Navbar-GlobalBioenergyPowerTracker}}
'''Severnside Energy-from-Waste power station''' is an operating power station of at least 38-megawatts (MW) in South Gloucestershire, West of England, England, United Kingdom.
It is also known as Suez West London, Severnside Energy Recovery Centre.
